fusions.name: Unbroken Line
fusions.desc: Sends a string of locusts through the first enemy it meets for 28 damage, then on to 4 more enemies within 4 tiles for 80% of that each. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Shackle Nip
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 20% for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Knotted Tether
fusions.desc: Strings a line of linked locusts 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Next Link Feeds
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
